stemMd: Exactly one of gates A and B is open. If A is open, the warning lamp is on. The warning lamp is off. Which gate is open?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Either A or B remains possible.

explanationMd: The unlit lamp rules out A by contraposition. Since exactly one gate is open, B must be open.

distractorRationale.d: An open A would require the lamp to be on.
distractorRationale.c: The lamp condition rules out A.
